responses_en: Hello! I am AgriBot-CAR. Ask me anything about soil types, NPK fertilizers, or our AI analysis.
Hi there! I can help you understand your soil scan, NPK levels, or taking a proper picture of your soil.
responses_il: Naimbag a bigat! Siak ni AgriBot-CAR. Agdamag maipapan iti kita ti daga, NPK abono, wenno ti AI analysis-mi.
Kumusta! Mabalin a tumulongak maipapan iti daga, abono, wenno panag-scan iti daga.

responses_en: Based on our 3-Model Stack thesis (SVM, XGBoost, Net-88), the AI is highly accurate on held-out photos: 85.48% Accuracy (77.10% Macro-F1) for Nitrogen, 78.42% (78.36% F1) for Phosphorus, and 84.37% (83.78% F1) for Potassium. However, this complements—not replaces—a lab test.
responses_il: Maibatay iti 3-Model Stack a panagadalmi, nangato ti kina-eksakto ti AI: 85.48% (77.10% Macro-F1) para iti Nitrogen, 78.42% iti Phosphorus, ken 84.37% iti Potassium. Ngem laglagipen a daytoy ket pammattian laeng, saan a mangsukat iti pudno a lab test.

responses_en: This tool was built using a 3-Model Stack trained on the SoilScan dataset. It combines SVM (Color), XGBoost (Color+Texture), and a Hybrid CNN (Net-88) for advanced image recognition. They vote together to predict NPK levels.
responses_il: Naaramid daytoy babaen ti 3-Model Stack nga inusar ti SoilScan dataset. Addaan SVM para iti maris, XGBoost para iti maris ken linis, ken Hybrid CNN (Net-88). Agtitinnulong dagitoy tapno pugtuanda ti NPK ti daga.

patterns: Should I scan on paper or in a container?
How to take a picture of the soil?
Kasano ti panangala ti ladawan ti daga?
Nasaysayaat kadi ti papel wenno container?
responses_en: For best results, place the soil flat on a white paper under natural light. Our data shows a color shift (Delta E) when scanning inside a container, which lowers accuracy. Avoid heavy shadows!
responses_il: Para iti kapintasan a resulta, ikabil ti daga iti nadalumpinas a puraw a papel iti lawag ti init. Ipakita ti datami nga adda panagbaliw ti maris no ukraden iti uneg ti container. Liklikan ti nalinong unay a pakaalaan!

patterns: What does Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium mean
responses_en: NPK stands for Nitrogen (leaf growth), Phosphorus (root and flower development), and Potassium (overall plant health and disease resistance). Finding the right balance is key to a good harvest.
responses_il: Ti NPK ket kayatna a sawen Nitrogen (para idadakkel ti bulong), Phosphorus (para iti ramut ken sabong), ken Potassium (para iti pigsa ti mula laban iti sakit). Masapul ti balanse a kaaduanda para iti napintas nga apit.

patterns: Ania ti kayat a sawen ti nangisit a daga?
responses_en: Dark or black soil usually indicates a high level of organic carbon and organic matter, which is excellent for planting and retains moisture well.
responses_il: Ti nangisit a daga ket kadawyan a mangipakita ti adu a nabulok a mulmula ken organic carbon, a nasayaat unay a pagmulaan ken nalaing a mangtengngel ti basa.

patterns: Why is it orange or red
responses_en: Red soil usually means it is rich in iron oxide but might be older, highly weathered, and less fertile. It often needs organic compost to restore nutrients.
responses_il: Ti nalabbasit a daga ket masansan nga aduan iti iron oxide ngem baka nakurang iti sustansia gapu iti kabayagna. Masapulna ti compost tapno maisubli ti kinaganusna.

patterns: Kulang sa nitrogen ano ang gagawin
responses_en: If Nitrogen is low, apply urea or plant legumes. For low Phosphorus, add bone meal or rock phosphate. For low Potassium, use potash or wood ash. Always check your specific crop requirements in the Cordilleras.
responses_il: No nababa ti Nitrogen, usaren ti urea wenno agmula kadagiti legumes. No nababa ti Phosphorus, mangikabil ti bone meal. Para iti Potassium, usaren ti dapo wenno potash. Kitaen latta ti kasapulan ti mulam ditoy Cordillera.

patterns: Can this replace a lab test?
Mabalin kadi nga isukat daytoy iti lab
responses_en: Disclaimer: This AI scan provides a fast, accessible estimate based on color and texture. It is NOT a complete replacement for a chemical lab test. Factors like soil moisture and camera quality can affect predictions.
responses_il: Palagip: Daytoy AI ket mangted laeng ti napartak a karkulo maibatay iti maris ken linis ti daga. SAAN a kasukat ti pudno a chemical lab test. Dagiti bambanag kas iti kabaasa ti daga ken klase ti camera ket mabalin a makaapektar iti resulta.

responses_en: You're welcome! Wishing you a bountiful harvest. Feel free to return if you have more questions.
responses_il: Agyamanak met! Sapay koma ta nasayaat ti apitmo. Agsublika laeng no adda pay kayatmo a damagen.
